tool_input.description: Inspect working dir and the stray path

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is CBOR as the wire serialisation format. The reasons given are better type safety and a closer fit with the schema.

The decision is recorded as #19 ("Switching over to cbor…"), which replaced the earlier msgpack choice. I left msgpack out of the file, as you asked. Nothing newer on record changes the format.

I hit one hiccup along the way: my first attempt to write the file failed on a parse error. I then wrote it with the Write tool. I confirmed the file is inside the repository, and git shows it as untracked. I haven't committed it.
